summary: Controller web UI modernization: token sheet with a dark theme, flat brand surfaces, header Actions menu replacing the menubar, collapsed Tasks strip with failure notices, off-canvas tree and icon toolbar on narrow screens, operator labels and relative times, grouped console toolbar with Focus mode, fuller Updates page Recorded under changelog version 0.4.5.

guide.reason: Navigation chrome, the Actions menu, the Tasks strip, Focus mode, the fencing Why disclosure and status labels changed what operators see and where; pages that described the removed menubar or the always-open task drawer were updated. Tasks 5–7 also updated create-, edit- and delete-virtual-machine.md, replace-a-failed-system-disk.md and software-updates.md in commit 0cc49ef; they are listed under paths.

api.reason: Presentation only: the same client-facing reads and writes, identities, request IDs and results; no Core command or contract changes.

roadmap.reason: No phase or acceptance-gate status changes; the desktop layout plan is evolved by the linked plan.

state.reason: No Controller or Core record changes. The Tasks strip and tree open/closed preferences (nex.dock, nex.tree) live in the browser's localStorage as a per-browser convenience with a fixed default; losing them changes nothing an operator must re-enter.

verification.method: npm --prefix web run typecheck; npm --prefix web test (tokens, ui, labels, dock and existing suites); npm --prefix web run build; python3 scripts/check_docs.py --worktree; python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -p 'test_repository_privacy.py'; python3 scripts/generate_api.py --check; tests/integration/phase1.py --browser with temporary state and simulated virsh (22 groups); tests/integration/ui_review_browser.py before/after captures at 1440x900, 1440x2000, 1024x768 and 390x844 with a labeled simulated inventory, inspected.
